observed_log.backtrace_limit: Native backtrace lacks useful per-function symbols;there is no GDScript bounds error or named customization callback frame. The first error and later SIGSEGV are temporally adjacent,but exact direct cause is not proven.

code_findings: Seven OptionButtons(two model/profile plus five palette choices) are created once and retain their internal PopupMenus.
Customization does not remove/free/reparent its PopupMenu;only ordinary Controls/CanvasLayer visibility and avatar geometry are changed.
Opening preview sets model_option.grab_focus after populating selections;model/profile selection callbacks change the avatar but do not close or reconstruct the UI.
The fixture selects via option.select(index) and item_selected.emit(index),so prior46/56PASS never exercised the ordinary OS dropdown open/keyboard focus path.
Default project settings do not override embedded subwindows;popup paths therefore use standard engine defaults.

official_sources.supports: OptionButton owns a required internal PopupMenu;do not remove/free it.
force_native forces an OS Window regardless of parent viewport or project embed setting.

Embedded subwindow focus looks up the target in the registered subwindow list and reports an invalid index if absent. This identifies the failing subsystem but does not alone prove the SIGSEGV root cause.

known_issue_status: No exact Godot GitHub duplicate was confirmed by this focused search. Do not describe this as an already-known fixed issue. Unrelated fullscreen macOS reports were excluded.
hypothesis: Native OS input or accessibility focus changed embedded PopupMenu focus registration while opening/selecting. The log is consistent with an engine embedded-subwindow focus failure;the exact triggering key is unknown.
